answer: Standing can rest on coin age, not token count: votes weigh one ticket per coin-day, and any transfer resets the clock. Splitting a matured balance across fresh identities earns almost nothing, since each clone starts at zero age and waits out the full maturation period, while the original keeps its anchor. An attacker cloning k ways pays k waiting periods before weight appears; time cannot be bought. Mature deposits accumulate like a glacier, slowly and per unit, and a transfer meant to bridge weight between accounts is blocked; the ledger rewards patience, not headcount.
